Instead of dooming how about "The Bull Case for equities for Q4"

I am short equities and long bonds at the moment so I don't need to wonder about the bear case.  I don't need doom porn or crash memes for black monday.  I need to consider where I am wrong. 

I'll break it down into reasons to be bullish equities. 

1. Earnings, earnings, earnings.  They are accruing at the SPX level at 30% ish annualized.  They will beat expectations over the next 5 weeks 
2. Valuations could easily richen though are pretty rich
3. Long term interest rates could have topped
4. The Fed has things handled and won't be forced to tighten
5. after
a) the election the president will end the war and bring oil prices down
b) The Congress is and will be in gridlock which will keep fiscal humming but not overheat
c) election uncertainty will dissipate
6. when equities are high going into year end. Winners are chased by those underperforming at the same time as those who are outperforming refuse to sell winners due to capital gains tax realization (Broadly defined causal Santa Claus rally)
7. Bessent could reduce duration issuance and support assets
8. Circular financing by all (NVDA in particular) will offset any supply or issuance that has been a headwind to compute investment 
9. Reflexive consumption/dissaving due to asset price increases could drive above trend real growth and support stocks over bonds 
10. It's possible that Hedge funds will/have been flushed out of positions and positioning is too bearish

I'm sure there are more bullish cases but these are some of mine.  I am not bullish as I don't think the above is a good case but it exists for sure
